sources.note: Main product homepage. Describes Drs Enterprise as a flexible, customizable EHR built around the patient chart. Lists physician testimonials, Nuance DAX/Dragon integrations, and Microsoft ribbon-style interface.

Detailed features page. Lists document management, narrative writer, ePrescribe, EOB manager, task manager, charge capture, telemedicine, HL7 lab interface, fax system, QR code scanning, security features, and practice management integrations.
Returned 404 at time of research. Mandatory disclosures page not accessible.
2025 Real World Testing Plan. References transitions of care, clinical information reconciliation, EHI export, CQMs, immunization registry, and syndromic surveillance testing.
Page about Nuance DAX Copilot integration for AI-powered clinical documentation.
Older company website with expired SSL certificate. Could not fetch content. Search results indicate it has the same product info as drsdoc.com.

Office Management Solutions (OMS) reseller page. Lists features including narrative writer, ePrescribe, EOB manager, task manager, PM interfaces. Confirms OMS is a value-added reseller (AIMSVAR member). Lists integrations with MicroMD, Medical Manager, Medisoft, MedFX, PCN.

FindEMR listing. 10 reviews, ~90% positive. Lists target specialties: sports medicine, orthopedics, ophthalmology, OBGYN. Mentions e-prescribing, telemedicine, document management, charge capture, appointment scheduling, patient portal, compliance tracking, reporting analytics.

SoftwareFinder listing. 4.6/5 rating from 10 reviews. Confirms telemedicine, instant messaging, charge capture, e-prescribing, audit trails. Lists billing and invoicing management and third-party PM integrations. Custom pricing model.

SourceForge listing. No user reviews. Confirms founded 1985, US-based, cloud-based platform. Lists features including e-prescribing, EMR/EHR, claims management, insurance eligibility verification, inventory management, multi-office/multi-physician support, patient billing/portal/records/registration/scheduling.
Capterra listing. Could not access (403 error). Search snippet mentions narrative writer, EOB management, eprescribing, forms processing, document management.
